7 categories to explore

Drag, swipe or choose a category

5 product lines · Fruits & Veg

Processed Fruits & Vegetables

Fruit pulps, purées and preserved vegetables for beverage, dairy, bakery, sauce and food-service manufacturing.

Formats & specifications

Aseptic bags in drums, OTS cans, bulk industrial food-grade packs; custom Brix and acidity specifications.

3 product lines · Dehydrated

Dehydrated Produce

Dried alliums and roots in calibrated cuts for seasoning blends, ready meals and food processing.

Formats & specifications

Flakes, kibbled, minced, chopped, and calibrated granules with controlled moisture below 6%.

5 product lines · Powders

Powdered Ingredients

Spray-dried and dehydrated powders for seasonings, soups, instant mixes and formulated foods.

Formats & specifications

Free-flowing food-grade powders in moisture-barrier liners for seasonings, soups, and instant mixes.

3 product lines · IQF Frozen

IQF Frozen

Individually quick-frozen vegetables for food-service, retail packing and industrial kitchens.

Formats & specifications

Blanched and quick-frozen at peak harvest to lock natural color, nutrition, and firm texture.

5 product lines · Spices

Indian Spices

Whole and ground Indian spices, cleaned and graded to the parameters agreed in your specification.

Formats & specifications

Steam-sterilized or raw, machine-cleaned, graded by ASTA / curcumin / volatile-oil specifications in 25 kg / 50 kg PP or Kraft bags.

5 product lines · Leaves

Botanical & Culinary Leaves

Shade-dried culinary and botanical leaves for herbal, nutraceutical, tea and seasoning applications.

Formats & specifications

Shade-dried to retain vibrant chlorophyll, natural aroma, and phytonutrients; bulk cartons or bales.

4 product lines · Nuts & Kernels

Nuts & Kernels

Cashews, groundnuts, almonds and desiccated coconut for snacking, confectionery, bakery and repacking.

Formats & specifications

Vacuum-flushed tins, flexi-pouches, and export cartons calibrated for moisture, count, and aflatoxin compliance.
